_comment: Business Studies -- Secondary School Teachers' Diploma syllabi, Years 1-2.
TITLE / LEVEL / YEAR. "Business Studies" (the manuscript's cover says "Business Studies Syllabi");
Secondary School Teachers' Diploma as the Preface says; 2025 as on the copyright line.
SIX COURSES IN ONE BOOK (courses). Financial Accounting, Commerce, Teaching Methods for Commerce and
Principles of Accounts, Economics, Business Mathematics, Business and Company Law -- each with its own
description, competences and matrix. Each opens a section of its own and keeps its own year pages.
The course-span lines under the titles ("YEAR 1 TO YEAR 2", "YEAR 1 – 2") go: the year pages say it.

1.8 COMMERCE, 1.9, 1.10 ... after Financial Accounting's, Business Mathematics typed 2.1-2.3 inside
Year 1). Counted afresh from the table structure, Year.Topic within each course.
